blocks.text: Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot condemned arson attacks that Israeli settlers are suspected of carrying out in the occupied West Bank as “Jewish terrorism.” He blamed Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s right-wing government, which he is currently working to replace, for the violence.
